style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean simple shapes, lots of calm open space. No text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of a prehistoric volcanic land like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO animals, NO dinosaurs and NO volcano: a warm orange and yellow evening sky with a few soft clouds, far away purple hills, some dark green ferns and cycad palms at the left and right edges, a few round dark rocks, a thin winding orange lava stream far in the back, and a wide flat brown and tan rocky ground across the whole bottom half of the picture.
